channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bones Hyland | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bones Hyland from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Bones Hyland
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on Bones Hyland, who had 14 points and closed the game:

“That's my boy. I've been a fan of him for the last 3 years... Sometimes you can just see, some people are just meant to be a star... I may not know the criteria to being a star. But if I think I do, I think he's one of em.”

Anthony Edwards on Bones Hyland, Dec 9, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Michael Porter Jr on Bones Hyland
item.description:
Michael Porter Jr. on Bones Hyland:

“If it doesn't work out here, I know he's going to be a star. So I know we're going to be looking back like, 'Dang.'”

Michael Porter Jr on Bones Hyland, Feb 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Bones Hyland
item.description:
Ryan Blackburn:Michael Malone on Bones Hyland not playing lately:

“It's a combination of things. He hasn't felt great lately physically...that's part of it. The other part of it is me just trying to find a group of guys that will go out there and give us some consistency.”

Michael Malone on Bones Hyland, Jan 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Michael Malone on Zeke Nnaji, Bones Hyland
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on Bones Hyland's ankle that he tweaked last night in Dallas, via @AltitudeSR:

“I don't think it's anything serious. But at the same time, I didn't think Zeke Nnaji's ankle was anything serious, but he missed last night.”

Michael Malone on Zeke Nnaji, Bones Hyland, Nov 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.
